data.title: Places in Town — Beginner · Lesson 3
data.subject: places
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey y'all, gather 'round…
Got some new neighbors in town.

[Hook]
New friends… Nuevos amigos
Come and see… Ven a ver
Where we go… A dónde vamos
You and me… Tú y yo
Exploring places, oh so free.

[Verse]
Strolling down the avenue,
Places to be, things to do.
Ice cream shop… La heladería
Sweet treats for you and me.
Nightclub's calling… La discoteca
Dance the night away.
Zoo's alive… El zoológico
Animals on parade.

[Hook]
New friends… Nuevos amigos
Come and see… Ven a ver
Where we go… A dónde vamos
You and me… Tú y yo
Exploring places, oh so free.

[Verse]
Aquarium's bright… El acuario
Fishes swimming 'round.
Fire station's bold… La estación de bomberos
Heroes standing proud.
Stadium's roar… El estadio
Games and cheers abound.
Airport's high… El aeropuerto
Planes taking flight.

[Bridge]
Marina's calm… El puerto deportivo
Boats on the bay.
Restaurant's warm… El restaurante
Dinner's served today.
Pharmacy's near… La farmacia
For when you need aid.
